states.name: Lü Bu
states.title: Revenant of a Wrathful Demon
states.description: She should have had no lingering regrets. And yet, when her eyes opened once more through the power of the Talisman of Revival, a single wish began to bloom within Lü Bu's heart— She wanted to see her again. Guided by that one simple, humble wish, she returned to the battlefield once more.

states.name: Lü Bu
states.title: Revenant of a Wrathful Demon
states.description:
Even after seeing how Musashi had been corrupted into an oni, Lü Bu's feelings did not waver. No matter how completely Musashi had changed in personality or appearance, she could not abandon her dear friend who was now truly alone.

And so, rather than choosing what was right, she chose to stand by Musashi's side.

states.name: Lü Bu
states.title: Revenant of a Wrathful Demon
states.description: Though Lü Bu was feared as the "Demon of Wrath", her heart was filled with deep affection and calm resignation. If neither of them could go back to the way they were before, then at the very least, they would walk together until the very end. She will no longer hesitate...even if that path led only to ruin.
